Paper-level embeddings use the abstract and keywords. KMeans selects a cluster count using cosine silhouette scores where possible. UMAP/PCA produces three-dimensional coordinates, then store.py tightens and offsets clusters for separation. One to three papers use fixed positions. Position is an exploratory projection and not an exact semantic distance. Similarity edges use cosine top-4 neighbours and a 0.20 cutoff. The renderer currently draws edges with a common visual style, so it should not be described as encoding edge weight by line intensity. Nebula shading uses a sampled density field and a GPU particle system. 3D benefits remain a usability hypothesis pending comparison with list and 2D layouts.

name: Auto / RAG / Chat modes make retrieval behaviour explicit.
text: Auto / RAG / Chat modes make retrieval behaviour explicit.

The default embedding model is BAAI/bge-m3, configurable through SCHOLAR_ST_MODEL. Paper embeddings use abstract and keyword text. chunk_text uses a 500-character window and 100-character overlap, preferring sentence boundaries. Indexing filters very short or poor-quality chunks. The vector store has separate scholar_papers and scholar_chunks collections with cosine distance. OCR is optional and falls back to native extraction when Tesseract is unavailable. MinerU requires a separate CLI installation. Auto keywords use corpus TF-IDF, mixed-language tokenisation and MMR diversity; declared keywords remain preserved.

search_chunks fetches max(top_k*5,20) candidate chunks, then applies a weighted reranking score: 0.72 semantic similarity, 0.18 lexical overlap and 0.10 text quality. The main query endpoint generally selects five chunks, or six in a named-paper search. Auto routing uses retrieval quality and raw semantic scores to choose rag, rag_soft or chat. Forced RAG without chunks can use rag_soft, so the product does not implement a universal strict refusal policy. The backend sends context and recent dialogue to the chosen provider and returns answer, cite_details, provider_used and mode. RAG improves access to evidence but does not eliminate hallucination.

name: Open the PDF page and highlight terms
text: Open the PDF page and highlight terms

The backend attaches references for the retrieved passages, then locate_snippet_page searches native PDF page text using normalised snippets and a keyword fallback. The main and reader chats render citation chips and source cards. Paragraph-to-source associations use lexical matching with a fallback, not semantic entailment verification. PdfReaderPane highlights matching PDF text-layer items and scrolls to the first hit. OCR-only pages, layout differences, or ambiguous keywords may prevent precise location. Citations expose possible supporting material; they do not prove every generated claim.

The frontend uses REST fetch calls, not a streaming websocket RAG channel. Vite development proxies /api and /files to 127.0.0.1:8000. Backend startup imports inbox PDFs and restores/checks indexes. Files and metadata use local directories and JSON. Chroma telemetry is disabled in VectorStore. Local Ollama is a built-in OpenAI-compatible provider; Gemini and custom providers share the model registry and HTTP client. Cloud inference receives prompt context and vision images when used. Embedding model acquisition may require network access initially. The project is a local research application and does not document production authentication or deployment hardening.

text: Validation: frontend build passes. Earlier manual tests cover previews, tooltips and nebula visibility.

Historic reports: DEMO records occlusion, responsiveness and directory sync issues; v1.1.1 records a pass for filename hover, nebula occlusion improvement and preview. The v1.2 folder report labels itself v1.1.1 and records keyboard/preview layout issues without a final resolution table. The current code includes bounded OrbitControls, adaptive rendering presets, quality-aware chunk reranking, keyword filtering, OCR/parser fallbacks, PDF viewer fallback, index warnings, model tests and graph refresh retries. Do not equate code presence with a completed regression pass. No benchmark supports a speed improvement percentage.
